what: Studio edit mode, 2026-10-28 ~21:40-21:50: a rigged copy of CarImport (CarRig.build, anchored, offset 100 studs on X) and an R6 built from a default HumanoidDescription at the driver's scale and at scale 1, its root placed explicitly (the description-built R6 pivots on its Head). The dummy is turned through 24 headings in 15-degree steps; overlap = workspace:GetPartsInPart of each colliding body part (Head, Torso) against the car; clearance = signed distance of the nearest corner of a colliding body part to the Hull box. Everything destroyed, leftover 0. NOTE: get_connected_instances listed server and client peers at the time (the owner was probably playtesting); the runs were on the edit peer only, reported to the coordinator.
